training_rule: Both asset and SPY target maturity strictly before decision date
evaluation_rule: All three models rank IDENTICAL S05-selected tickers
costs: NOT INCLUDED: all performance plots are GROSS CLOSE-TO-CLOSE diagnostics; use S06 for NET implementation

selection_warning: Selection is based exclusively on validation metrics; test labels are evaluation only
strong_caveat: Validation labels may have shaped the original frozen S05 configuration; new ranking models fit only past matured labels at each date
